placements.title: Team process changes move from ratified decision to a format the team actually runs
placements.frame: How does a team process change get adopted, and what does the adopted format consist of, and when did it replace the format before it?
placements.why: The position holds a team's ratification of the Velociraptor retro format (src-1, decision-grade), its structure of Sailed, Stalled and Capsized (src-2), and its replacement of start-stop-continue last sprint (src-3). Future envelopes about how the team changes its own working practices will keep feeding this subject, so it is a theme rather than a fact. No existing leaf fits: Narrative_AnalyticsPlatformChoice concerns analytics database choices, not team process.
consulted: Narrative_AnalyticsPlatformChoice (declined: analytics database choice, not team process adoption)

mints.name: OperatingCadence
mints.title: Operating cadence: the team's retro ritual, its format, and what replaced the one before it
mints.why: The retro is a recurring team ritual that sets how the team reviews its work, which is the kind of thinking the scheme's OperatingCadence coordinate names (rituals such as postmortems that create momentum). No existing stratum holds this grouping: AnalyticsPipelineDatabase is thematic about the database choice, and StreamingIngestionGap is causal about Zypherion.

connections.why: The narrative is about how the team adopts and runs its retro format, a recurring operating ritual.
The position holds the retro format's adoption, its three-section structure, and its replacement of the prior ritual, which makes the cadence grouping legible.
